description: This file is a Java source file defining an abstract base test class for OpenMRS API tests using JUnit 5, Spring testing, and DBUnit. It manages test setup, database initialization, authentication, and dataset loading for testing within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: BaseContextSensitiveTest
classes.description: Abstract base class for OpenMRS API tests, providing setup, teardown, dataset management, and authentication utilities.

methods.name: initializeInMemoryDatabase
methods.description: Sets up the in-memory H2 database with initial test data before each test.

methods.name: executeDataSet
methods.description: Loads a dataset from classpath file and executes it (refresh operation).

methods.name: executeLargeDataSet
methods.description: Loads and executes a large dataset directly from file without caching.

methods.name: executeXmlDataSet
methods.description: Loads a true XML dataset from classpath file and executes it.

methods.name: deleteAllData
methods.description: Removes all data from all tables in the database, effectively resetting the state.

methods.name: updateSearchIndex
methods.description: Updates the search index for specified entity types.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the current JDBC connection from Hibernate.

methods.name: getRuntimeProperties
methods.description: Provides runtime configuration properties, including database connection info.

methods.name: useInMemoryDatabase
methods.description: Determines whether to use an in-memory H2 database for testing.

methods.name: askForUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Displays a Swing dialog to prompt for username and password.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs user authentication, with fallback prompt if needed.
